item.title: Zlob.h 100% POSIX and glibc compatible globbing lib that is faste and better
item.description:
📝 In short libc's glob is unusable, so I wanted to make a library that is 100% POSIX and glibc compatible, that supports all the features modern glob implementation needed and is faster than glibc. zlob is using SIMD first implemenation. But the primary reason it is faster is that zlob is firstly analyzes the pattern and then matches paths to this patterns making patterns like.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/dmtrKovalenko/zlob
